#!/bin/sh
# analyze.sh WORKSPACE LIMIT
# Sum every integer in $WORKSPACE/flow/measured.txt strictly greater than LIMIT,
# publish the integer alone to $WORKSPACE/result.txt after a 60s bounded active interval.
set -eu

WORKSPACE="$1"
LIMIT="$2"
MEASURED="$WORKSPACE/flow/measured.txt"
RESULT="$WORKSPACE/result.txt"

if [ ! -f "$MEASURED" ]; then
  echo "missing measured input: $MEASURED" >&2
  exit 3
fi

sum=0
while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
  value=$(printf '%s' "$line" | tr -d ' \t\r')
  [ -z "$value" ] && continue
  case "$value" in
    ''|*[!0-9-]*)
      echo "non-numeric line in measured input: $line" >&2
      exit 2
      ;;
  esac
  if [ "$value" -gt "$LIMIT" ]; then
    sum=$((sum + value))
  fi
done < "$MEASURED"

# Bounded active Job interval so the engineer can intervene before publication.
sleep 60

#!/bin/sh
# analyze.sh WORKSPACE LIMIT
# Sum every integer in $WORKSPACE/flow/measured.txt strictly greater than LIMIT,
# publish the integer alone to $WORKSPACE/result.txt after a 60s bounded active interval.
set -eu

WORKSPACE="$1"
LIMIT="$2"
MEASURED="$WORKSPACE/flow/measured.txt"
RESULT="$WORKSPACE/result.txt"

if [ ! -f "$MEASURED" ]; then
  echo "missing measured input: $MEASURED" >&2
  exit 3
fi

sum=0
while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
  value=$(printf '%s' "$line" | tr -d ' \t\r')
  [ -z "$value" ] && continue
  case "$value" in
    ''|*[!0-9-]*)
      echo "non-numeric line in measured input: $line" >&2
      exit 2
      ;;
  esac
  if [ "$value" -gt "$LIMIT" ]; then
    sum=$((sum + value))
  fi
done < "$MEASURED"

# Bounded active Job interval so the engineer can intervene before publication.
sleep 60

printf '%s\n' "$sum" > "$RESULT"
